title: InvoiceDocument - Data API
description: Tracks and displays the status of documents generated for invoices. Invoice documents are available in the related lists of invoice entity records. This object is available in API version 61.0 and later.

ContentDocumentId.description: The ID of the generated PDF document. This field is a relationship field.

DateGenerated.description: The date on which the PDF is generated.

DocumentGenerationProcessId.description: The ID of the entity that contains the information used to create the PDF invoice. This field is a relationship field.

DocumentNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
DocumentNumber.description: The ID of the generated document.

ErrorMessage.description: Errors that occur during PDF generation.

InvoiceId.description: The ID of the invoice entity to which the invoice document is attached. This field is a relationship field.

Status.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Status.description: The status of the PDF generation process. Possible values are: Blocked Cancelled Failure Pending Success
